purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL 85 conformance test suite - on-site validation program testing 3-dimensional and 7-dimensional table construction and access using PERFORM, SET, subscripts, and indices
purpose.summary: Program NC242A is part of the NIST COBOL 85 validation test suite. It tests construction and access of three-dimensional and seven-dimensional tables using Format 4 PERFORM statements with subscripts converted to indices via SET. Access is verified via IF statements using numeric literal and constant subscripts.

notable_features: INDEXED BY clauses with multiple indices (IDX-1 through IDX-3, IX-1 through IX-7)
